actor.name: Abu Musa and the Greater and Lesser Tunb

stances.note: Abu Musa and the Greater and Lesser Tunb has not written its reading of United Arab Emirates; the atlas mirrors United Arab Emirates's 'claimed territory' reading as 'rival' at low confidence, on the same evidence. Bond and trend are not assessed from this side.

sources.title: Gargash asserts UAE's right in 3 islands, replies to comments by Khamenei's adviser
Iran deputy foreign minister: Abu Musa and the Tunbs are integral parts of Iran
Could the UAE use the cover of war to retake the Gulf islands from Iran?

stances_toward.note: Abu Musa and the Greater and Lesser Tunb, occupied by Iran on 30 Nov 1971 (the eve of the federation) and claimed by the UAE ever since; Gargash restated the claim on 4 Oct 2026 and Iran's deputy foreign minister answered in late September that the islands are 'integral parts of Iran'. Abu Dhabi asks for talks or the ICJ, not force; the Gulf States Newsletter asked in March 2026 whether war could change that. Claimed, not controlled.
